name: Kneeling rope cable crunch
definition: Kneel facing a high pulley with a rope held near the sides of the head. Flex the trunk against cable resistance, then return without deliberately turning the movement into a hip hinge.

catalogue_anchor.notes: Original broad muscle labels retained separately; not silently promoted to accepted anatomy.

value.start: Kneel facing a high pulley with a rope held near the sides of the head.
value.movement: Flex the trunk against cable resistance, then return without deliberately turning the movement into a hip hinge.
value.finish: Finish at the original kneeling torso position.
value.range_of_motion: Repeatable trunk-flexion range and cable line; hips remain relatively fixed.
